title: Grand East Village
address:
3950 Columbia St
Orlando, Florida 32805
United States
description:
Grand East Village is a $30 million affordable housing community for adults 62 and older on Columbia Street in Orlando. The three-story, garden-style property spans 96,715 square feet and holds 92 units, each with its own washer and dryer and energy-efficient appliances.

Shared amenities include a resort-style pool and sundeck, a fitness center and pickleball courts, a theater room and media lounge, a community room with a catering kitchenette, a dog park and sunroom, on-site generators, and package lockers for deliveries.
